mechanism: Foscarnet causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) which impair renal function and increase isotretinoin toxicity; both drugs are teratogenic with additive reproductive/developmental risks.
action: Avoid concomitant use if possible; if necessary, monitor renal function, electrolytes, and lipids closely; ensure strict contraception protocols for isotretinoin; consider alternative antivirals.
